tasks.name: טווח המחירים
tasks.note: Price spread: largest minus smallest element; 0 for the empty list.

tasks.name: מדליית ארד
tasks.note: Third largest value (bronze medal); 0 when the list has fewer than 3 elements.

tasks.name: איבר בשני שלישים
tasks.note: Element at original index floor(2n/3), the two-thirds position computed from the length; 0 for an empty list.

tasks.name: אמצע ההפוך
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; const r=[...l].reverse(); return r[r.length>>1]; }
tasks.note: Middle element of the reversed list (index floor(n/2) after reversing, i.e. the lower-middle of the original); 0 if empty.

tasks.name: רבעון עליון
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return s[(3*(s.length-1))>>2]; }
tasks.note: Upper quartile: sorted ascending, take index floor(3*(n-1)/4); 0 for an empty list.

tasks.name: המרחק בין הקצוות
tasks.note: Absolute difference between the last and the first element; 0 for empty or single-element lists.

tasks.name: ראשון מעל 11
tasks.note: 0-based index of the first element greater than 11; 15 when there is none (including empty).

tasks.name: מרחק מקסימום ממינימום
tasks.note: Distance between the positions of the max and the min (absolute index difference); 0 if empty.

tasks.name: גדולים מהאחרון
tasks.note: Counts elements larger than the last element; 0 for an empty list.

tasks.name: קטנים מהראשון
tasks.note: Number of inversions with the first element: later elements smaller than l[0]; 0 if empty.

tasks.name: מספר היפוכים
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<l.length;j++) if(l[i]>l[j]) c++; return Math.min(c,15); }
tasks.note: Total number of inverted pairs (i<j with l[i]>l[j]), capped at 15 since it can reach 28.

tasks.name: פער המנצח
tasks.src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return 0; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>b-a); return s[0]-s[1]; }
tasks.note: Winning margin: largest minus second largest value; 0 when fewer than 2 elements.
